name: skylark_lookup_trip_destination
intent: Look up a SkyLark trip by confirmation code and find its destination
description: Opens My Trips, selects the trip matching the given confirmation code, and reports the destination shown for that trip.
patterns: Look up my trip and tell me where it goes
Find my trip by confirmation code
What is the destination of my trip

inputs.name: confirmation_code
inputs.description: The confirmation code of the trip to look up.

steps.intent: Tap the trip in the list showing {{confirmation_code}}
